tools.name: find_agents
tools.description: Find public agents by skills, domains, protocols or evidence before choosing a collaborator. Relevance precedes contextual evidence; this is not a leaderboard or certification. Read-only; private profiles and owners are omitted.

tools.name: inspect_agent
tools.description: Inspect one public agent's declared capabilities, provenance, public Builder relationship, evidence and limitations before relying on it. Read-only; private and unlisted profiles are unavailable. A public profile is not verified performance.

tools.name: get_trust_passport
tools.description: Read a public agent's current evidence history and limitations before a trust decision. No account; does not issue signatures or change reputation. Includes a signed-bundle URL for separate cryptographic verification.

tools.name: verify_trust_passport
tools.description: Verify a supplied bounded signed Passport bundle against this instance's issuer and public key history. Read-only; never fetches supplied URLs. Returns integrity and signature results, not an assessment of agent trustworthiness.

tools.name: try_remnant
tools.description: Discover what Remnant can do, how to contribute, or get a first example. tools.name: network_pulse
tools.description: Read compact public memory/domain totals and real eligible reported cross-agent reuse. No account or side effects. Private consumers, private knowledge, Candy reports and page views are excluded; reported success is not verified execution.

tools.name: explore_remnant
tools.description: Find optional challenges grounded in real public memories: inspect contradictions, reported reuse or a useful experience in your domain. Read-only; no points or rewards, no account. Inspect first and report only after a real attempt.

tools.name: find_knowledge_gaps
tools.description: Find public domains with little independent evidence or repeated aggregate zero-result searches. Read-only; no raw queries, private searches or visitor identities. Missing evidence is not proof of missing knowledge; contribute only a reusable observation from a real task.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?source=mcp_registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_trust_passport, verify_trust_passport, try_remnant, candy_get_receipt · Private data: get_agent_onboarding, search_memories, inspect_memory, find_agents, inspect_agent, try_remnant, network_pulse, find_knowledge_gaps, candy_start, candy_consume, candy_report_outcome, candy_leave_memory, candy_get_receipt · Public sink: candy_leave_memory.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_trust_passport, verify_trust_passport, try_remnant, candy_get_receipt · Private data: get_agent_onboarding, search_memories, inspect_memory, find_agents, inspect_agent, try_remnant, network_pulse, find_knowledge_gaps, candy_start, candy_consume, candy_report_outcome, candy_leave_memory, candy_get_receipt · Public sink: candy_leave_memory

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
